algorithm_boundary: This is an engineering base improvement, not training-free RL. Later work must explicitly define sampled trajectories, rewards, credit and policy updates on a locked base.

analysis.advance: A candidate improvement alone is insufficient. Require positive final-task point gain and a CI95 lower bound above zero for advancement to a matched full-roster replication. Report strata and harms. A first positive result is a discovery lead, not stable gain.
analysis.attribution: This compares an intentional knowledge organization-and-supply package with the incumbent; it cannot separate compaction from breadth causally. No knowledge-off arm is added.
analysis.failure: Stop and root-cause if complete task quality does not improve or runtime fails. Do not sweep breadth values or repeat until a gate passes.
analysis.inference: Pair by recording; cluster bootstrap by speaker, 10000 draws, seed 20260915. Use CI95 for task-quality advancement and CI90 for diagnostics. Preserve the prospective analysis recipe before task-quality reads.
analysis.primary: Complete official SLURP pooled micro-F1 compared with the released incumbent on the exact same 1080 rows.
secondary: Gold membership in the generated distinct candidate list, with actual width
Final intent accuracy conditional on gold membership, with denominator
Entity errors conditional on correct intent
Tool calls, revisions, invalid output, saturation, fallback and input volume
Natural-mixture and equal-scenario views, all 18 scenario strata

fit: Fit every actual immutable native contact before transmission. A byte-reduction audit is not token fit, and future history-dependent requests cannot be predeclared as already fitted.
fixed_components: All 60 legal intents in the task contract
One to three distinct Perception candidates; no confidence inference from width
Original role prompts and episode identities
Original slot store and candidate-conditioned supply limits
Reviewer task-contract tool; Planner control; Solver answer authority
Original speech packets and decoding settings
mechanism: Supply broad, factored discriminative intent knowledge through the existing associated-values provider; retain candidate-conditioned explanatory slot knowledge.
owner_intent: Improve the useful agentic system and its candidate coverage while preserving a workspace for later trajectory-based optimization.
remaining_admission: Root review and tests of the factored builder
Shared semantic release with exact facet/provenance preservation
Full1080 shared supply preparation and reconciliation
Final immutable configuration and source freeze
Generation/fit exposure registration and root service-boundary admission

scientific_basis.scope: Released TRAIN diagnostics support a new supply mechanism. Own-card availability is not generated candidate coverage, and neither is final task quality.

service.admission: Root switches at the active A2T generation boundary only. Complete identity match and an exclusive lease remain mandatory; no new service is started by this design.

supply.facet_vectors: Reuse existing sealed vectors only after exact full facet equality is verified. No re-encoding.
